meta.title: Bestim: your car's maintenance history, trusted and effortless
meta.description: Log your car's maintenance by voice or by hand, follow reminders and expenses, and keep a history you can trust and share when you sell.

hero.title2: Keep a history you can trust.
hero.body: Every service saved, every reminder on time, every expense in one place. Ready to share when you sell.
hero.phoneAlt: A vehicle in the Bestim app: odometer, this year's expenses and the parts that need attention
hero.voice: “Changed engine oil at 134,550 and paid 1,200 EGP”

features.body: From the first oil change to the day you sell.

items.title: Voice logging
items.body: Say what you did the way you'd tell a friend. We sort out the service, odometer and cost, and you review before saving.

items.title: Clear reminders
items.body: We work out the next service by distance and time, and remind you ahead of it. Snooze when you need to.

items.title: Expenses at a glance
items.body: A yearly total, monthly bars, and categories that show where your car's money goes.

items.title: Corrections keep the original
items.body: When you edit a record the original stays saved and the change appears beside it. That keeps the history trustworthy.

items.title: Export and share
items.body: Export the history as PDF or CSV, or share it by QR code or link with the new owner.

items.title: Works offline
items.body: Log anywhere. We keep the record on your phone and upload it when you're back online.

how.title2: and your car's history is safe.

steps.title: Say it or type it
steps.body: Tap the log button and say what you did: “Changed the oil at 125k and paid 1,200 pounds.” Or enter it by hand.

steps.title: Review and save
steps.body: We show the details sorted out: service type, odometer reading, cost. Edit anything and attach a photo of the receipt.

steps.title: Get reminded on time
steps.body: We work out the next service and notify you ahead of it, so nothing slips.

expenses.title: Know where your money goes
expenses.body: A clear total for each year, and a monthly breakdown for every vehicle.

reminders.title: Never miss a service
reminders.body: Parts that need your attention show up first.

vehicles.title: All your vehicles, one account
vehicles.body: Car, motorcycle, pickup or equipment. By kilometers or by operating hours.

share.title: Share it by QR code
share.body: The buyer scans the code and receives a copy of the car's history.

guest.title: Try before you sign up
guest.body: Browse the app as a guest, and create your account when you're ready.

trust.body: A complete, dated service history reassures the buyer and makes selling easier. Share it by QR code or link, and choose what it shows.
points: The original and the correction both stay visible. Nothing is erased
Suspicious odometer readings are flagged for review
You choose what to share: costs, receipts, notes
trust.alt: A record details screen with a correction

connect.title1: Run a workshop or a fleet?
connect.body: A dashboard for workshops and fleet owners: records verified in your workshop's name, and every vehicle followed in one place.

points.title: Workshop-verified records
points.body: Log the service on your customer's car so it appears in its history, verified by your workshop.

points.title: A whole fleet on one screen
points.body: Vehicles, drivers and the cost of each vehicle, without scattered spreadsheets.

points.title: Reminders for the entire fleet
points.body: Maintenance alerts for every vehicle, ahead of time.

items.a: An app that keeps your vehicle's maintenance history, reminds you of upcoming services and tracks your expenses. In Arabic and English.
Yes. You can log maintenance without a connection, and the record uploads automatically when you're back online.
Cars, motorcycles, pickups and equipment. Track them by kilometers or by operating hours, and add more than one vehicle.
Yes. Nobody sees your records and receipts unless you share them. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from inside the app.

items.q: How do I share my car's history when I sell?
items.a: From the vehicle page choose Share. You get a QR code or a link that is valid for 7 days. The receiver gets a copy of the history.

items.q: Do I need an account to try the app?
items.a: No. You can browse the app as a guest first, then create an account with email or Google to keep your records.

items.q: When will the app be available?
items.a: Soon on the App Store and Google Play.
